source_scores.coverage: Matched frozen101, frozen104 and new count102 only; other75 previous candidates keep frozen source metrics without new scores.

contract.primary_seller: Highest item price, then lowest item sequence; unchanged static-export lookup.
contract.history: Valid purchase <= approval, other order identity, approval in [t-90d,t).
contract.observed_event: Carrier/customer event strictly < t. Event equal to t is unknown.
contract.pending: No carrier event observed before t AND no customer-delivery event observed before t.
contract.observed_anomalies: Observed carrier before approval, delivery before approval, delivery before observed carrier, and delivery observed without observed carrier are quarantined from pending. Future carrier/delivery timestamps never exclude a row.
contract.zero_and_missing: Known seller with no pending orders: count=0, age p90 missing. Unknown seller: both missing; unknown sellers are never pooled.
contract.age_quantile: Linear p90 of (t - historical approval) hours among pending; minimum 1 pending order, fixed diagnostic rule, not the 104-column handover min-5 rule.

cohorts.common_missed_delayed: Known delayed and no alert from any of the three fixed models.
cohorts.other_known_delayed: Known delayed and alerted by at least one fixed model.
cohorts.unknown_outcome: Outcome unavailable at the original historical cutoff.

contract.ranking: Original full closed daily batch floor(0.1*N), unknown outcomes compete before cohort masks; no cohort reranking.
contract.interpretation: Prespecified descriptive bins test coverage, not model gain or causal mechanism. Repeated validation months have different cutoffs and cannot be summed as independent months.

availability_matrix.signal: Transaction, geography, completed delivery, undelivered and overdue workload, route/promise 7/14-day changes
availability_matrix.coverage: Already included in all three 101/102/104 models; not new.
availability_matrix.assumption: Static export attributes and historical event < t ingestion assumptions.

availability_matrix.signal: Primary seller 90-day completed handover event count and elapsed p50/p90
availability_matrix.coverage: Count already in102/104; p50/p90 already in104. Old logistics inventory predates those branches.
availability_matrix.assumption: Other orders carrier < t; order-level handover proxy; min5 events for104 quantiles.

availability_matrix.coverage: Not in101/102/104; calculated here only as diagnostic descriptors.
availability_matrix.assumption: Absence of an observed carrier is not verified physical non-dispatch; static primary seller, timely ingestion and missing cancellation clocks remain limitations.

availability_matrix.signal: Item shipping_limit_date schedule and promise-after-dispatch schedule
availability_matrix.coverage: Existing8-feature dispatch sensitivity branch; not a new untested signal.
availability_matrix.assumption: No creation/revision history proves approval-time schedule version; not an actual handover event.

availability_matrix.signal: Own future carrier/customer-delivery timestamp, elapsed actual handover/transit duration
availability_matrix.coverage: Excluded as own-order approval predictors; later checkpoints change population/budget.
availability_matrix.assumption: Never import future event or duration into approval model.

availability_matrix.available_later: final status/reviews only; transition timestamps absent
availability_matrix.coverage: Snapshot final status and downstream reviews cannot reconstruct as-of state.
availability_matrix.assumption: Approved cancelled orders may remain in unobserved-event queue.

availability_matrix.signal: Carrier ID/service, parcel scans/position, ingestion timestamps, weather and holiday source
availability_matrix.coverage: Not supplied by nine raw tables; weekday already exists.
availability_matrix.assumption: Needs actual external/versioned sources; cannot invent from ZIP or final timestamps.

query_quality.scope: Overlapping historical order occurrences across queries, not unique raw orders. Anomaly categories overlap.

limitations: These are unobserved-event proxies, not verified physical queues or parcel-level seller handovers.
No cancellation, event ingestion or static attribute revision timestamps are available.
Two diagnostic columns are outside all three fixed model input whitelists; no recall gain is measured.
Outcome-conditioned descriptive distributions do not establish predictive gain or feature causality.
All phases are reused historical validation/development; repeated months with different cutoffs overlap.
All operational queries and observed event clocks are strictly before2018-05-01; original holdout is unchanged.
